blocks.en: DIVORCE. Unlawful connections. Matt. 5:31, 32. (Whosoever shall put away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, causeth her to commit adultery.) Matt. 19:3-9. (What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.) 1 Cor. 5:1-5. 1 Cor. 7:11, 13-15, 39. See Commandments, Seventh; Family; Marriage.
blocks.zh: 离婚。不合法的结合。马太福音 5:31-32 ——（只是我告诉你们，凡休妻的，若不是为淫乱的缘故，就是叫她作淫妇了。）19:3-9 ——（所以，神配合的，人不可分开。）哥林多前书 5:1-5。7:11, 13-15, 39。另参主题词条：十诫之第七诫（043）；家庭；婚姻。

grammar.note: Whosoever shall put away his wife：whosoever 复合关系代词（凡休妻的）；put away：古义『休弃』。
let not man put asunder：let 祈使的否定式（人不可分开）；asunder：古副词『分开地』。
saving for the cause of fornication：saving = except（古介词『除了』），与今分词 saving 无关。
